rapport_notes: Friendly and non-pushy; when the customer said he'd shop around, the rep genuinely encouraged him to take the better rate if he found one.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do we have any specific concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call?" -- asked right after the quid pro quo, before any other question.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "it does not necessarily mean that you need to pay for three and a half hours, even if you end up less than that" -- pay-less-if-faster covered.

top_strength: Handled the 'I'm going to shop around' close gracefully and warmly instead of getting pushy, preserving the relationship for a callback.
coaching_note: The estimate was given as a bare range ($704-$854) without spelling out why (e.g. "since it's just two beds, a console table, and a short loading-dock walk") -- naming the specific factors would make the range feel more credible.
